account.deleted: Your account was deleted. Thanks for being part of the community.

pwa.iosInstall: To install on iPhone: tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".

auth.inAppNote: It looks like you opened this from inside an app (Instagram, Facebook…). Google blocks sign-in there. Tap ⋯ and choose "Open in browser", then come back here.

push.iosInstallFirst: To get notifications on iPhone, first add onefan to your Home Screen.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. You can allow them there.
push.turnOff: Turn off notifications on this device
push.note: Goals, final whistles, messages and ride requests. Never the message contents.

chat.firstMsgNote: The first message arrives as a request. {nick} decides whether to continue.

dm.requestIntro: {nick} wants to message you. They can keep writing only after you accept.
dm.sentWaiting: Message sent. You can write again once they accept.
dm.badCodeHint: The fan may have created a new barcode. Ask them to show you the barcode again.
dm.emptyBody: Message any fan in the league, or start a small group for the crew you sit with.
dm.requestsSub: Fans who want to message you
dm.qrHint: Another fan scans the barcode with their phone camera and can message you right away.
dm.qrResetConfirm: The current barcode will stop working, even if someone screenshotted it. Continue?
dm.qrResetFail: We couldn’t create a new barcode. Try again.
dm.scanUnsupported: This browser can’t scan barcodes. Open your phone camera and point it at the barcode: the link opens on its own.
dm.scanDenied: No camera access. You can allow the camera in your browser settings, or scan with your phone camera.
dm.searchFanPlaceholder: Search a fan from your club by nickname
dm.lockedBefore: A message sent before this device was set up
dm.e2e: End-to-end encrypted. Not even we can read it.
dm.notOpenedDm: {nick} hasn’t opened private messages on their device yet. You can send once they do.
dm.replyGone: The message you replied to is no longer available
dm.sentToOtherDevice: Sent to another device of yours
dm.compareCode: Compare with {nick} (face to face or by phone). If the code matches, no one is impersonating in the middle.
dm.notInGroup: You’re no longer in this group
dm.groupEmpty: No messages yet. Be the first to write.
